newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners remain biggest yen bond buyers in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners remain biggest yen bond buyers in Dec.

text.p: Foreign investors continued to be the largest buyers of yen bonds in December, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Monday.
Foreigners' net purchases in December totalled 1.3931 trillion yen, up from 968.5 billion yen in November.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
The vast bulk of foreigners' buying, 1.5811 trillion yen worth, was in short-term bonds.
